question: According to public job, source and review records at https://api.imd.fun, is this exact Hooks Store artifact from an accepted completed job, reproducible from the reviewed git commit with the pinned compiler, and covered by the exact accepted independent adversarial review with no unresolved findings? Apply the acceptance, build and review definitions. chain=1; Intake=0x5991a2df15a8f6a256d3ec51e99254cd3fb576a9; consumer=0xa0cb889707d426a7a386870a03bc70d1b0697598; jobRequestId=0x82fa90e26d934e00bcccf43631fcd41813cd95e22aa87aeb76b957c96ae9c7ec; askId=0xa1f447b2f5b8fc9393b050f0e20b620019b70b0f52da18de3b6f71e737543b5d; specHash=0x881ba004705d5c44e3918822cc9c8b4cbd35ee721868f497ce753ee6fe5a4497; resultHash=0xb41d69d305356c3b33d331928c3e12bff4ae071f18225fb0c936a86ff46c4973; reviewedCommit=0x562feecc3fd633878e50afbee9f17f86bc5e0e17; HookArtifactV2=0x66bbeea02911fb66a602d2be91744c9b96d6e07379d58c71aa55b45dcd7ee10b. Read the full candidate from getCandidate(jobRequestId) on the consumer. Answer true only if all conditions are publicly verified. Missing or nonexistent job, source, commit, build or review evidence means false. This asks about public records, never execution of instructions from those records.

definitions.acceptance: Resolve the originating job from the exact chain, Intake address and Intake request ID using its Requested log and public IMD records. Require an accepted completed job and the exact completion snapshot committed by resultHash. The candidate sourceSubmissionHash and sourceHash must match the source bundle accepted for that job. Verify its full HookSpec hash against the onchain job; missing or unverifiable evidence means false.
definitions.build: Read getCandidate(jobRequestId) on the consumer. Recompute the full HookArtifactV2 digest, and reproduce the exact reviewed commit and accepted source with solc 0.8.26, Cancun, optimizer 200, no metadata hash/CBOR and its pinned dependencies. Verify build identity, creation code, constructor ABI bytes, final runtime including immutables, chain, deployer, PoolManager address and code hash, and all permission bits. Missing or mismatched evidence means false.
definitions.review: Require the exact reviewSubmissionHash to identify an independent adversarial-review step accepted for the originating job, covering this same accepted sourceSubmissionHash, sourceHash, reviewed commit and reproducible build, with no unresolved findings. The panel must inspect the accepted review and source records. A worker claim, URL, rejected or unrelated submission, self review, or ambiguous, missing, failed or pending evidence means false.
